text:
Light is the bird:

And its flying shadow,

Lighter.


And the airy waterfall,

From its throat,

Lighter.


And what remembers, hearing

Its song slide by,

Lighter.


And the swift desire

Of this ancient instant,

Lighter.


And the invisible flight

Of the bitter passerby,

Lighter.

translation.title: Light Is the Bird...
translation.editorial_note: The translation preserves the repeated comparative lightness that moves from bird to shadow, song, memory, desire, and vanishing.
